Maria — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a concise concession matrix and two clear paths. TL;DR: we can do either, but the pilot-credit route gets you a guaranteed migration SLA and a defined block of professional services hours (preferred for lower operational risk); the per-token match is cleaner commercially and better if your finance team wants to avoid upfront credits.

Highlights from the attached matrix:
- Pilot credit: $25,000 one-time credit earmarked to a 6-week pilot (kickoff, ingest, validation, go/no-go). Includes 40 PS hours and a guaranteed 4-hour severity-1 response window during cutover for 30 days post-live. 12-month standard run-rate at 14% below list for the first year (then reverts).
- Per-token match: 12% off our list generation rate for 12 months (no credits). No included PS hours; onboarding is quoted separately.

Ops note (from Kimberly, below): typical onboarding calendar requires a 3-4 week lead for infra allocation and an additional 4-6 weeks for integration and acceptance testing for the pilot. If you prefer the per-token approach and want a faster timeline, we can compress the pilot scope but would need a short-run Statement of Work to capture the agreed cutover support.

I've attached: concession_matrix.xlsx, redwood_sow_draft.pdf. Happy to hop on a call tomorrow to walk through.

Best,
